'''Akaan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]]. Located within the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]], Akaan occupied the second [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Mandalore (star)/Legends|Mandalore]], between the orbits of [[Nog]] and [[Tracyn]]. A [[Desert/Legends|barren]] world without an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], Akaan was orbited by two [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. After the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] forces of [[Mandalore the First/Legends|Mandalore the First]] journeyed from [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] to conquer the uninhabited planet that became [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="TEA" /> the newly renamed [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] spread out to conquer the planets of the surrounding system,<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> including Akaan.<ref name="TEA" /> The world's name came from the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] word ''akaan'', meaning "war".<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Akaan was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].
